title: Fixed: internet.username Was Broken (Typo'd as userName)

Fixed: Fixed internet.userName being registered in the faker function catalog and shown in skill.md — Faker.js renamed this method to internet.username (lowercase n) in v8, and this plugin depends on @faker-js/faker ^10.4.0, where internet.userName no longer exists at all. Using {{$faker.internet.userName()}} silently failed and left the literal unresolved placeholder text in the request instead of throwing or generating a value, since executeFakerFunction catches the missing-property error and falls back to returning the original expression unchanged. Verified the fix against the real installed library: all 46 catalog entries now resolve to an actual function, up from 45/46 before.

Fixed stale 2-column headers-table/query-table examples in skill.md (Key, Value only) — these table types moved to 3 columns (Key, Value, Description) a while back; see the same fix already shipped in plugin-voiden-rest-api's skill.md.
Removed catch-all shim so @faker-js/faker bundles inline correctly — fixes CI build failure

Added: Commerce, finance, and internet faker categories
Seed support for reproducible fake data
Improved: Slash command autocomplete now shows category previews
